body_text:
The characteristic of a ring with identity is the least
positive integer $n$ such that $n\cdot1=0$, if such an integer
exists, and is $0$ otherwise. The characteristic of an integral
domain is either $0$ or prime. Consequently every field
contains a canonical copy of either $\mathbb{Q}$ or a finite
prime field $\mathbb{F}_p$.
